name: Xero
description: Xero is cloud accounting software for small businesses, accountants, and bookkeepers. It brings invoicing, bank reconciliation, bills, expenses, reporting, payroll integrations, and financial records into one online workspace.
agentUseSummary: Connect one organisation with a Xero Web app owned by your business, then let agents inspect bounded organisation metadata and privacy-redacted invoice summaries through three read-only tools. V1 excludes financial writes, contact identity, line items, payments, attachments, bank data, payroll, reports, administration, automatic pagination, and arbitrary Xero API calls.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer-owned Xero Web app, matching client credentials, and one authorized Xero organisation are required; this code-only worker does not create provider apps or capture credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a Xero Web app owned by the customer, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/xero/callback, enter its client ID and secret in Relay Console, authorize exactly one organisation, and verify all three reads, rolling refresh, disconnect, revocation, scope denial, and tenant denial in staging.

evidence.supports: Xero Web apps use authorization code OAuth, HTTP Basic client authentication at the token endpoint, thirty-minute access tokens, and rolling refresh tokens.
The V1 surface needs offline_access, accounting.settings.read, and accounting.invoices.read; broader transaction scopes are unnecessary.
The connections endpoint binds an authorization event to exact tenant and connection UUIDs and supports exact connection deletion.
Xero's current connection tiers charge for scaled distribution, so Relay does not own or subsidize a shared Xero OAuth app under the customer-paid-provider policy.
Public Xero App Store distribution requires a paid tier and certification checkpoints; customer-owned Web app credentials avoid making Relay the paid distributor.
